# Test Matrix Type

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

Test whether the diagonal matrix diag(1,0) is positive semidefinite. The result is true despite its zero eigenvalue.

## What this example demonstrates

Test whether the diagonal matrix diag(1,0) is positive semidefinite. The result is true despite its zero eigenvalue.
